criteria.statement: NFR-002 defines cold-start model readiness (wall-clock, process start to first System 3 query embedding, packaged on-disk cache, no network call) and requires it to stay a small enough share of the 3-second answer target

NFR-002's Notes record the 2026-09-05 local measurement (181.2 ms cold-start model readiness; 1.05 ms steady-state) and require the deployed figure to be read from the Lambda function's own cold-start log line
